about: Where each hook input fixture came from. {{NAME}} values are filled in by tests/hooks/fixtures.mjs; a value that is exactly one placeholder takes the placeholder's type (for example a boolean).
claude/session-start.startup.json: Recorded from a real Claude Code 2.1.280 session (claude -p with a logging hook, 2026-09-26); paths and ids replaced with placeholders.
claude/user-prompt.json: Recorded from the same real Claude Code 2.1.280 session; the prompt text replaced with a placeholder.
claude/session-start.resume.json: The resume example in the captured Claude Code hooks page (hooks.md, SessionStart input).
claude/pre-tool.write.json: Claude Code hooks page: common input fields plus PreToolUse input for Write.
claude/pre-tool.edit.json: Claude Code hooks page: PreToolUse input for Edit.
claude/pre-tool.multiedit.json: Claude Code hooks page: PreToolUse input for MultiEdit.
claude/pre-tool.bash.json: Claude Code hooks page: PreToolUse input for Bash.
claude/post-tool.write.json: The PostToolUse example in the Claude Code hooks page.
claude/post-tool.edit.json: Claude Code hooks page: PostToolUse input for Edit.
claude/post-tool.bash.json: Claude Code hooks page: PostToolUse input for Bash (tool_response has stdout, stderr, interrupted, isImage).
claude/stop.json: The Stop input example in the Claude Code hooks page.
codex/*.json: The Codex generated input schemas (codex-rs/hooks/schema/generated/*.command.input.schema.json, main branch, read 2026-09-26): every required field, no others. apply_patch and Bash tool_response are strings, as in codex-rs/core/tests/suite/hooks.rs.
